run_evaluation_main: run the main evaluation function to extract losses and compute metrics on the IntPhys-test dataset
extract_losses_from_videos: extract per-sample reconstruction losses from video clips using a pretrained JEPA encoder and predictor model
compute_surprise_metrics: compute maximum and average surprise metrics from a tensor of per-sample reconstruction losses
load_pretrained_checkpoint: load pretrained checkpoint weights into the encoder, target encoder, and predictor model state dicts
init_model_with_pretrained: initialize a vision transformer encoder, target encoder, and predictor or VideoMAE model from a pretrained checkpoint
